logp.method_description: A shake-flask method was used to determine the log P values of the platinum complexes. Five micromoles of platinum complexes were dissolved in 2 mL of PBS buffer (pH = 7.4); a 0.5 mL solution of these platinum complexes was mixed with 0.5 mL of octanol that was presaturated with PBS buffer (pH = 7.4). The two phases were shaken at room temperature for 8 h and then separated by centrifugation. The platinum content in the two phases was determined by ICP-OES. The log P values were calculated from an average of three independent measurements.
